desc: The honesty layer: every condition not fully compiled into the expression language, classified. judgment-input = RONR is judgment-shaped here by its own account; the condition enters via the adjudication machine or a recorded world-fact, and that is the CORRECT model, not a defect. schema-gap = the model's schema/grammar does not yet carry what a full compilation needs; stage 5 (or a later stage-4 pass) should close it. annotation-grade = normative content preserved as cited annotation on structured data, consumed by a human/LLM reader or a later compilation pass, not yet by the evaluator.

judgment_inputs.status: correct-by-design: the judgment content arrives as an input event; the routing around it is fully compiled
world-facts the assembly knows and the engine cannot derive; supplied with events

schema_gaps.where: rules.json resolution; guards act-in-order-under-governing-rules, rule-suspendible, continuing-breach
schema_gaps.gap: which rules cover which acts, and which unsuspendable category covers which rule, is content classification. The closed category lists are data; the per-rule classification is a recorded field on rule records (content-not-name [2:24]) that adopted-rule ingestion must supply. The guards' quantifications assume derived queries (governing_rules_forbidding, unsuspendable_matches, breach_grounds_matching) whose classification inputs are those fields.
schema_gaps.severity: the largest genuine gap; rules-resolution is only as formal as the rule records fed to it

schema_gaps.where: actions.json (raise-point-of-order, appeal, object-to-unanimous-consent, give-previous-notice, respond-to-inquiry, read-paper, declare-recess-or-adjournment); guards.json series-in-progress
schema_gaps.gap: several ["event-occurred", ...] scopes use informal scope tokens ('just-now', 'pending-consent', 'since-ruling', 'breach-just-occurred', 'series-declared-open', 'reconsider-being-made', 'orders-call-refused', 'heading-reached'). Each is implementable as a history query, but the scope algebra (windows between events) deserves first-class schema treatment: a Window type {opened_by, closed_by} generalizing the timer expires_on_event pattern.
schema_gaps.severity: mechanical; no rule content is missing, only query formalization

schema_gaps.where: precedence.json applies_to for limit-extend-debate / previous-question; Order.covers
schema_gaps.gap: the qualified forms cover 'a consecutive series from the immediately pending question' [15:5(2), 16:5(2)]; the series-selection parameter (which frames the mover named) is an action parameter not yet typed — Order.covers receives it, but the move action's params don't carry it
schema_gaps.severity: small; add a series-scope param to the move action for these two motions and for division-of-question

schema_gaps.where: registry.json vote_exceptions / vote_notes / reconsider conditional objects / notes fields
schema_gaps.gap: threshold-exception selectors (e.g. main-motion's suspends-a-rule -> two-thirds [10:8(7)]; committee reconsider two-thirds-with-drop [37:35(3)]) and reconsiderability windows (until-progress, before-execution, unexecuted-part) are typed-prose annotation, not yet compiled selectors. The window vocabulary is closed and small; a later pass should enum-ify: reconsider windows {always, until-target-taken-up, until-progress, before-any-vote-under-order, unexecuted-part, once-person-notified} and threshold selectors as expr alternatives.
schema_gaps.severity: medium; these fire at threshold-selection and R2 evaluation time

schema_gaps.gap: 'debate-exhausted' is named as an event but is derivable: no timely floor claim for debate AND all counters at limit, OR an unexhausted PQ/close-debate order covers the frame; should be compiled as a derived expression rather than an input event

body_kind-dependent rule variants (committee thresholds [35:2(7), 37:35(3)], no-limit reconsider window [37:35(1)], call-for-orders excluded in committee-of-the-whole [18:6], speech counters in committee) are handled where the components carried them, but there is no systematic body_kind overlay; a full committee-rules pass ([49-52]) was outside the stage-3 components' scope
schema_gaps.severity: known-incomplete region inherited from the decomposition, now explicit

schema_gaps.gap: the model conflates 'out of order' with 'unnecessary' in one spot (the call between questions when no order is neglected is unnecessary rather than improper [18:5]); available_actions should distinguish absent-because-blocked from absent-because-moot for chair guidance, a distinction the justification structure supports but no field yet names

annotation_grade.content: germaneness rules [12:16-21], filling-blank ordering [12:107-111], renewal rule-cluster details [38:1-9], not_applicable lists for reconsider/rescind [37:9(2), 35:6] — the last two are consumed as the recorded reconsider_excluded / unrescindable inputs

annotation_grade.where: engine.json serialization on_report / protocol.json requests, decorum, voting_exchange prose fields
annotation_grade.content: procedural sequencing detail preserved with citations; the actions and events it constrains are in the compiled layer, the fine sequencing is stage-5 orchestration
compiled at the guard level; the two-thirds set-aside sub-votes are ordinary motions through the normal action path
